steps.body: Get the thought down without editing as you go. Typos, run-ons, no punctuation — that is the input DuoTyping expects.

items.title: Local by default
items.body: Detection runs on a bundled local model with zero network entitlement at the OS level. Nothing leaves your Mac unless you turn on Cloud AI yourself.

items.title: Suggests, never rewrites
items.body: Every fix is visible before it happens. Accept what is right with one keypress, skip the rest — DuoTyping never silently changes what you wrote.

items.title: Tone by domain
items.body: A legal email and a Slack message do not get the same advice. DuoTyping calibrates suggestions to the app and audience you are writing for.

items.title: Aims to fade
items.body: A coaching layer tracks the patterns you keep repeating, so the goal is needing DuoTyping less over time — not more.

PrivacySection.heading: Your writing

items.q: Which apps does it work in?
items.a: Every app on your Mac. DuoTyping reads and corrects text wherever your cursor is, so there is nothing to integrate — Mail, Slack, Notes, Notion, Pages, Xcode, your terminal, any browser text field.

items.q: Is there a Windows, iPhone or web version?
items.a: Not yet, and there's no Windows beta right now. DuoTyping is macOS-only on purpose: a sandboxed local model, Apple Silicon inference and zero network entitlement are what make the privacy story structural instead of a marketing claim.

items.q: What does it need to run?
items.a: macOS 14 or later, on Apple Silicon. Intel Macs aren't supported — the local model needs Apple Silicon to run fast enough to feel instant. It's a native app that idles at well under 1% CPU.

items.q: Does it rewrite my writing for me?
items.a: No — it never rewrites silently. DuoTyping detects grammar, tone and structure issues and shows you the fix; accepting is always one keypress you choose to make. Heavier paraphrasing is a separate, opt-in step using your own Cloud AI key.

items.q: Will it flatten my writing into AI voice?
items.a: That's the failure mode we designed against. Suggestions fix grammar, run-ons and tone mismatches — they don't rewrite your word choices for you. Paraphrasing only happens if you explicitly ask for it.

Detection runs locally by default with zero network entitlement at the sandbox level — your text can't leave the Mac even in principle, not because of a setting you could get wrong. Cloud AI is opt-in, uses your own API key, and nothing is stored after the response or used for training.

items.q: Why does it need Accessibility permission?
items.a: So it can read and correct the field you're focused on anywhere on the system, without a plugin per app. DuoTyping only ever reads the field you're actively typing in — never your screen at large.
